greet.speaker: Elder
greet.text: Welcome, traveler. What brings you to our village?

choices.text: I'm looking for the ancient sword.

sword_info.speaker: Elder
sword_info.text: Ah, the ancient sword... it lies deep within the Whispering Caves, north of here.

warn.speaker: Elder
warn.text: Be careful. Many who enter do not return.

passing.speaker: Elder
passing.text: Safe travels, then. The road can be dangerous at night.
